top_signals.title: US Sells Venezuela-Linked Tanker Seized After High-Seas Chase
top_signals.summary: The US government has sold a Venezuela-linked oil tanker seized by its Coast Guard in January after a dramatic chase across the Atlantic, clearing the way for the dark-fleet ship to be demolished, according to the buyer.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Air India Pilot Tests Positive for Drugs
top_signals.summary: The captain of an Air India Ltd. jet that suddenly dropped about 300 feet on a flight last week tested positive for illegal drugs in a second screening, according to people familiar with the matter. Bloomberg's Mihir Mishra shares what the reporting so far can reveal. (Source: Bloomberg)
